ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent wrapper built with ConnectRPC and Vercel AI SDK that monitors challenge server infrastructure and applies real-time prompt-injection hardening and request validation against automated exploitation tools.
ideas.title: CTF-Guard Live Defense-in-Depth Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses security hardening and defense-in-depth principles relevant to competitive capture-the-flag events, mirroring winning strategies from recent personal agent and cybersecurity challenges.

ideas.pitch: A graph-based intelligence platform using LightGBM and network mapping to visualize and score the attack surface of web application binaries and trace complex multi-step exploit chains.
ideas.title: Vulnerability Graph Intelligence Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leans into genuinely hard engineering by combining machine learning risk scoring with graph intelligence to accelerate vulnerability discovery during CTF challenges.

ideas.pitch: A ZK-gated submission portal using Noir circuits that allows teams to prove they possess a specific flag or exploit hash on-chain without revealing the raw string or solution to neighboring teams.
ideas.title: Zero-Knowledge Flag Verification Portal
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies cutting-edge zero-knowledge proofs to solve the classic CTF problem of flag leaking and sharing, showing high technical sophistication that stands out to judges.

ideas.pitch: A rapid automated code audit tool that parses repository structures, flags insecure deserialization, hardcoded secrets, and common web exploits before deployment.
ideas.title: RepoInspector Security Insight Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the core theme of responsible vulnerability discovery and ethical hacking by providing instant repository security insights.

ideas.pitch: A real-time log analysis system powered by a fine-tuned BERT model that classifies incoming web requests into legitimate traffic versus malicious exploit payloads, updating the live scoreboard context.
ideas.title: BERT-Powered Exploit Log Classifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines natural language processing with security log analysis, following the proven blueprint of runner-up cyber hackathon winners that integrate robust machine learning classifiers.
